start.welcome:
👋 Hi! I help you use VPN subscriptions (Happ/INCY) in apps that do not send a HWID.

I bind a stable HWID to your subscription, fetch it from the provider and serve it to you without a HWID via our domain.
help.text: 🤖 How it works: 1. Add the origin link (from your provider). 2. I generate a HWID once and bind it to the origin. 3. Use a link like {0} in any app. 4. On every subscription refresh I attach the stored HWID and pass the content through as-is. Commands: /add — add a subscription /subs — my subscriptions /lang — language / язык /cancel — cancel the current action
add.ask_url: Send the origin subscription link (the provider's link, e.g. https://example.com/sub/abc123).
add.ask_name: Send a name for the subscription (or press "Skip").
add.invalid_url: ⚠️ This does not look like a valid http(s) URL. Try again or press "Cancel".
add.invalid_name: ⚠️ The name is too long (max 64 characters). Try again.
subs.empty: You have no subscriptions yet. Press "Add subscription".
subs.title: 📋 Your subscriptions ({0}):
origins.title: 🌍 Origins of "{0}" ({1}):
origin.ask_url: Send the origin link to add to "{0}". It gets its own HWID.
origin.added: ✅ Origin added, its HWID is bound.
origin.last: ⚠️ Cannot delete the only origin. Delete the subscription instead.
sub.delete_confirm: ⚠️ Delete subscription "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
sub.rename.ask: Send a new name for the subscription (max 64 characters).
